name: How do I choose the right color and texture for aging-in-place flooring?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right color and texture for aging-in-place flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right color and texture for aging-in-place flooring involves considering both safety and aesthetics. Opt for matte or low-sheen finishes over highly glossy ones, as they reduce glare and provide better slip resistance. Avoid overly busy or contrasting patterns that can be disorienting or create an illusion of unevenness, which can increase fall risk for those with visual impairments. Colors that subtly contrast with walls or furniture can aid in spatial perception. Textures should provide grip without being rough, allowing for easy movement of mobility aids and comfortable walking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select matte finishes to reduce glare and improve grip. Avoid busy patterns. Choose colors that contrast subtly with walls. Ensure textures provide grip without impeding mobility.
